integrity: The arbitrary-dimensional proof uses the exact rank-k supporting inequalities, projection of their normals to the trace-zero tangent space, the Ky Fan variational principle, orthogonal averaging, and the orbit description of extreme points. The finite checker only corroborates exact formulas on small dimensions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical real-symmetric Schur-Horn orbitope with the intrinsic Frobenius metric. It is not affine invariant and does not claim the analogous Hermitian statement. A residual literature risk remains that parts of the metric transfer appear under matrix-nearness or spectral-function terminology, although no inspected source gave the explicit radius, complete incenter, and contact-rank formulas.
title: Frobenius radii and contact ranks of every Schur-Horn orbitope
